docs.summary: An animator driven by an [`AnimationGraph`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimationGraph) (state machines, blends, IK, sub-graphs). Set control parameters, then [`Update`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimatorBase~Update) evaluates the graph and pushes the pose to the engine. Subclass it and implement the [`AnimatorBase`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimatorBase) hooks to bind it.
